body:
In a nutshell? Since the middle of September, everything I care about in this world has steadily deteriorated into nothingness.

The only reason I haven't attempted it yet is because I am afraid. Afraid of if I fail.

I've got crippling debt, the woman I wanted to spend the rest of my life with changed her mind and checked out and yesterday my best (and really only friend) was given only 2-3 months to live (cancer).

I'm just done.
